## About
Domingo Lopez started Fully Loaded Automotive after years of watching car owners get stuck in the middle. The factory side blamed the aftermarket, the aftermarket blamed the factory, and the customer didn't get the service they deserved.
So this shop does both. Precise diagnostics and quality aftermarket installations, done so the vehicle and the person driving it are treated right. Aftermarket equipment goes in to manufacturer specifications so it works with your vehicle the way it should.
The owner lives in and contributes to the community this shop serves. We stand behind the service we provide to every customer, and we're thankful for the support of our neighbors in San Antonio.

## Services
- Car audio sales and service: Stereo upgrades and car audio work.
- Custom car audio fabrication and factory style installations: Custom builds, or installs that keep your vehicle looking factory.
- Complete upfitter sales and services
- Push-to-start conversion
- Remote start and security (alarm) sales and service
- Automotive lighting sales and service
- Window tint, color change vinyl and paint protection film
- Vehicle and electrical diagnostics and repair: Tracking down problems and fixing them.
- Brake diagnostics and repair
- Shocks and struts
- Paintless dent repair with paint chip repair

## FAQ
Q: Do you only do car audio, or do you fix cars too?
A: Both. Along with audio and upfitting, the shop handles vehicle diagnostics and repair, electrical work, brakes, and shocks and struts.

Q: What if the service I need isn't listed?
A: Give us a call and ask. We take calls for other automotive services too.

Q: How do I get in touch?
A: Call or email, or leave your info through the contact form and we'll get back to you.
